title: check_quote_members_bulk
description: Load many quote members from a spreadsheet and check addresses and serviceability in the background (10,000+ members, batches, retries, resume). Inputs: quoteId (Id or name), membersCsv (header row: name/site, street/address, city, state, postal code/zip, country – read the attached spreadsheet and pass its rows) or contentDocumentId (069...), checks (address, serviceability; none to only load). ALWAYS mode=preview first (columns, rows to load, duplicates, rows with errors); after the person approves, mode=commit with previewToken and same inputs. Then track_codey_job; when done share the results file.

mode.description: preview (default), commit after approval, or status.

membersCsv.description: CSV text with a header row (name/site, street/address, city, state, postal code, country).

contentDocumentId.description: ContentDocument Id (069...) of an attached CSV.

jobId.description: Codey job id for status or resume.

previewToken.description: Token from the preview, for commit.

confirmProduction.description: true only if the person confirmed in production.

message.description: Plain-language result to tell the person.

previewToken.description: Returned by a preview; pass it back with mode=commit and the same inputs only after the person approved.

fix.description: How to resolve a problem when success is false.
